args.content:
Packing List for Hawaii Vacation

Based on the vacation plans, here is the comprehensive packing list:

**Essentials:
  • Passport and travel documents
  • Plane tickets and hotel reservation
  • Travel insurance
  • Credit cards and cash
  • Driver's license

**Clothing:
  • 3-4 tops/shirts
  • 2-3 pairs of shorts/pants
  • 1-2 swimsuits
  • 1-2 light jackets (evenings can be cool)
  • Undergarments and socks
  • Comfortable hiking shoes
  • Sandals/flip flops
  • Dressier outfit for luau

**Beach/Pool:
  • Beach towel
  • Sunscreen
  • Sunglasses
  • Beach bag
  • Water bottle
  • Snorkeling gear
  • Water shoes

**Hiking:
  • Hiking poles
  • Water bottle
  • First aid kit
  • Snacks
  • Map
  • Sunscreen
  • Insect repellent

**Electronics:
  • Smartphone
  • Laptop
  • Camera
  • Portable charger
  • Power adapter

**Personal:
  • Toiletries
  • Prescription medication
  • Contact lenses/glasses
  • Phone case
  • Travel adapter

**Miscellaneous:
  • Reusable bag
  • Snacks
  • Reading material
  • Beach umbrella
  • Collapsible cooler
  • Water purification tablets

**Notes:
  • Hawaii weather: warm days, cooler evenings
  • Diamond Head hike: bring water and snacks
  • Luau: dressier outfit recommended
  • Pearl Harbor: bring ID and water
  • North Shore: bring sunscreen and water

**Total Packing Weight:** approximately 40-50 pounds

**Packing Strategy:
  • Pack essentials in carry-on
  • Use packing cubes
  • Roll clothing
  • Wear heaviest items (hiking boots) on plane
  • Use hotel laundry service for extra clothes

**Created on:** June 2024

**File Owner:** Emma Johnson

**File ID:** 8

**File Size:** 2KB

**Last Modified:** June 2024

**Shared with:** emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com (rw)
